abstract: We analyzed clinical and histopathologic data of 97 pediatric patients who underwent excision of dermoid cysts. On review, 16.5% of the sample population demonstrated localized chronic inflammatory changes, including the presence of giant cells and epithelial disruption. These features were considered indicative of prior cyst rupture. Age at time of initial presentation was significantly older and cyst size was significantly larger in patients with histopathologic signs of previous rupture. Longer time to presentation and time to excision were associated with increased odds of spontaneous rupture.
abstract_ja: 我々は、類皮嚢腫の切除を受けた97名の小児患者の臨床および病理組織学的データを解析した。再検討したところ、対象集団の16.5%に、巨細胞および上皮の破壊を含む局所的な慢性炎症性変化がみられた。これらの所見は、以前の嚢胞破裂を示すものと考えられた。初診時の年齢は、病理組織学的に以前の破裂の所見を有する患者で有意に高く、嚢胞径も有意に大きかった。初診までの期間および切除までの期間が長いほど、自然破裂のオッズ比が高かった。
